title: Two strips beneath a folded corner
description: Trace the blue fold outlines and unfold the red punch sites onto the original grid.

difficulty.label: Uncalibrated
difficulty.basis: Follow VH then a finite diagonal fold. Track 3 punch sites through stacks of [2, 5, 5] layers.

question: The original paper is a 5x5 grid. The top row of images shows the effect of folding the grid paper 3 times. Folds may be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal. The rightmost image in the top row shows the result after punching the marked cells. Which image shows the paper after it is unfolded? Black solid circles represent holes in the grid squares. Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.

answer.explanation: Read rows from the top and columns from the left. R2C5 pierces R1C5, R2C5. R3C5 pierces R1C1, R1C4, R2C1, R2C4, R3C5. R4C5 pierces R1C2, R1C3, R2C2, R2C3, R4C5.

options.label: A
options.explanation: Missing holes: R1C1, R1C2, R1C3, R1C4, R1C5. Extra holes: R5C1, R5C2, R5C3, R5C4, R5C5.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Missing holes: R1C1, R1C2, R1C3, R1C4, R1C5. Extra holes: none.

options.label: C
options.explanation: Missing holes: none. Extra holes: R5C1, R5C2, R5C3, R5C4, R5C5.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Every hole matches. Read rows from the top and columns from the left. R2C5 pierces R1C5, R2C5. R3C5 pierces R1C1, R1C4, R2C1, R2C4, R3C5. R4C5 pierces R1C2, R1C3, R2C2, R2C3, R4C5.
